# Lesson 1: Keeping an evidence trail

## Goal

Keep source values, calculation and interpretation consistent.

## Worked example

For the synthetic values 1, 2 and 3, the mean is `(1 + 2 + 3) / 3 = 2`.
An evidence record contains the three inputs, the calculation, the result, and
the date or version of the example. If software is used, add its version and
the command or source file needed to reproduce the calculation.

## Check your understanding

Explain why a screenshot of the result alone does not identify its inputs.
Then continue to the [practice task](../exercises/01-practice.qmd).
